# Tappi AI

> Tappi is a flexible, AI-assisted workspace: tables, docs, and views (table,
> kanban, timeline) that adapt to the workflow you build on them. This site
> demos Tappi through an ESG (Environmental, Social, Governance) supply-chain
> traceability use case.

## Site Structure

- Home: /
- About: /about/
- ESG Demo: /esg-demo/

## Discovery

- /sitemap.xml — full list of all pages
- /robots.txt — crawl policy
